reported.title: No debounce: bouncing contacts toggle lamp multiple times per press
reported.description: The loop reads the raw pin and calls isPressedEdge() on every HIGH-to-LOW sample (lines 50-56) with no settle window, so each bounce edge is treated as a new press. Measured evidence shows 4 toggles per press in the bounce scenario and 7 in the bounce storm, versus the required exactly one. Release bounce also produces spurious HIGH-to-LOW edges, explaining the 12 and 6 toggles with no press. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D11 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
